a: When a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves its current area while activation is pending, the effect can no longer be activated.
In this case, the deleted card's [On Deletion] effect triggers, but it's removed from the trash before the effect can activate.
q: I used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to delete an opponent's Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect, and I used the part of the effect after "then" to return that card from their trash to the bottom of the deck.
Can that deleted card's [On Deletion] effect activate at such times?

a: They become face-up security cards that remain revealed.
Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.
Card Q&A.q: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?

a: The check is performed with the card left revealed.
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.
Card Q&A.q: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?

a: Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards.
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.
Card Q&A.q: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
